holdout_card.fact_statement: Large scale operations in Northwestern Syria had ceased since the March 2020 Idlib ceasefire agreement prior to the 2024 offensives.
holdout_card.source_span: Since the March 2020 Idlib ceasefire agreement, large scale operations ceased between opposition and pro-government forces in Northwestern Syria.

qa_variants.question: What prior agreement had caused large scale operations in Northwestern Syria to cease before the 2024 offensives?
qa_variants.source_span: Since the March 2020 Idlib ceasefire agreement, large scale operations ceased between opposition and pro-government forces in Northwestern Syria.
